intent: Apply also/and, before, when unsure, may and rather than to responsibilities and visitor needs through a purposeful help-seeking picture contrast and a timed original visit.
picturePurpose: Original paired beginner scenes distinguish asking an experienced person from being alone while unsure; exact roles and the limits of the illustration are written in code. It is not evidence of an accident, a completed repair or actual bicycle safety. Literal source cards and a numeric visit model carry exact details.

workshop.title: 看清职责、条件和访客需求
workshop.instruction: 对照求助图片，补全职责与倾听，再为有明确时间限制的访客安排一次短参观。

items.label: also补充职责，不是只会修
items.prompt: What does Mr Chen add to repairing bicycles?
items.answer: He also checks safety before people ride.
items.reason: That is part承认修理只是工作的一部分，also补充骑行前检查安全；不是否定修理，也不是转去卖车票。
items.hint: 留住also、when unsure、may与rather than的条件；区分举例、建议和已经发生的结果。
items.material:
Student: Do you mostly repair bicycles, Mr Chen?
Mr Chen: That is part of my work. I also check whether they are safe before people ride them. A loose brake can cause trouble.
Student: What should a beginner learn first?
Mr Chen: How to inspect carefully and ask for help when unsure.

Mr Chen does repairs and also ____.
Original fictional illustration examples, not a record of Mr Chen or an accident:
Both beginners are unsure.
Picture A shows the unsure beginner asking an experienced mechanic for help.
Picture B shows the unsure beginner alone with a wrench; help has not yet been requested.
The pictures show help-seeking roles, not a completed repair, an accident or a verdict on bicycle safety.

transfer.stem: Which account keeps the librarian’s principle and its limits?
transfer.passage:
NEW TRANSCRIPT PRACTICE — AUDIO PENDING
Ming: Is your library job mainly putting books back?
Librarian: That is one part. I also help visitors find information. Accurate facts matter, and so does listening to what each visitor needs.
Ming: Would you give a researcher and a young first-time visitor the same introduction?
Librarian: They may need different introductions. I ask first rather than decide only from their appearance. If I am unsure of an answer, I check or ask a colleague instead of inventing it.
Read this new transcript as preparation; it is not a listening score.

options.text: Keep facts accurate, ask about visitors’ needs and check or seek help when unsure; introductions may differ.
Keep facts accurate, but give everyone the same introduction because listening does not change the plan.
Listen to visitors, but assume their needs from appearance and invent answers if checking would take time.

answer.display: Keep facts accurate, ask about visitors’ needs and check or seek help when unsure; introductions may differ.

explanation.strategy: 职责不止最先提的一项；同时保留事实、倾听和不确定时核实，并守住may的范围。

steps.text: 摆放图书只是一部分，还要帮人找信息；事实准确与倾听需求同时重要。
steps.reason: also与and so does表示补充，不是让倾听取代事实，或让事实成为拒绝调整的借口。

steps.text: 先问需求，不只看外表；不确定时核实或求助，讲解可能不同。
steps.reason: may不等于每次必须不同；instead of inventing排除为了省时而编答案。

distractors.reason: 保留事实准确这一点对，却否定倾听对安排的作用，并把所有人固定成同一种介绍。
倾听方向对，却又只凭外表假定需求，还把不确定时核实或求助改成编答案，违背两处明确限制。

explanation.pitfall: 补充职责不是否定原职责；面对不同人要先问，不能把may变成按外表一刀切。

segments.text: I check or ask a colleague

visual.caption: 没有根据外表替访客下结论，也不把还没核实的信息编成事实。

explanation.transfer: 如果只因访客看起来年轻就替他决定要什么介绍，为什么即使讲的事实准确，也没有照做先问需求的原则？
